universe_filter: accelerating quarterly EPS and revenue growth, return on equity around 25%, strong analyst ranking; stock in uptrend with index uptrend
conditions: fundamental screen passes
index (S&P 500) in uptrend
stock already trending up
entry_trigger: technical timing on an existing uptrend (unspecified indicator)
target_or_exit: pre-defined expected gain (example 8-10%); then trail stop tightly; typical hold 1-6 weeks, longer if trend persists
management: trail stop upward; tighten hard once target reached
stated_edge: earnings growth drives prices; three of four stocks follow the index trend
mcf_translation: daily bars: long when SPY > 50-day MA and stock > 50-day MA; 8% hard stop; at +8% move stop to breakeven-plus/trailing 3%; fundamentals filter not available

universe_filter: low-priced stock that has spiked multi-day on promotion/hype (press-release campaign, social hype) with weak fundamentals (little cash, going-concern, insiders with cheap shares)
conditions: stock already spiked strongly over several days on promotion
signs the pump is ending (momentum stalls)
entry_trigger: short once the move shows signs of collapsing (not specified precisely)
management: may hold 1-3 days waiting for the collapse
stated_edge: promoted stocks are lifted to let insiders sell or finance; once buying stops they collapse 50-75%
stated_stats: anecdotal: single-day collapses of 20-70% on shown trades
data_needed: promotion/news flags, SEC filings, short-locate availability, sub-$5 universe
mcf_translation: daily bars: universe price < $5 with 3-day gain > 100%; short the first day close < prior-day low (first red day); stop above the prior-day high; exit at -20% or at close

time_of_day: orders placed pre-open from end-of-day data
conditions: stock pulled back / weak over recent days (exact oscillator not given)
long only, buying into weakness
entry_trigger: pre-placed order computed from prior close (likely limit below close; not specified)
management: high frequency: 800-1000 trades/yr across the universe
stated_edge: large caps mean-revert after short-term weakness; frequency gives consistency
stated_stats: 22-45% annual return in one recent year; ~800-1000 trades/yr; avg hold 3 days
data_needed: historical S&P 500 membership to avoid survivorship bias
mcf_translation: daily bars: S&P 500 stock above 200-day MA, RSI(2) or 3-day decline extreme, buy limit ~2-3% below prior close next day, exit on close > prior high or after 3-5 days

universe_filter: stocks outside the top 100; index/regime filter implied
conditions: price breakout to new highs (buy strength)
market regime up (revert to cash when market falls)
target_or_exit: exit on trend reversal / trailing stop; average hold 6-8 months
management: portfolio of positions, fixed fractional sizing ~0.5-0.8% risk each
stated_edge: stocks must trend; small losses, occasional large winners (example +87%)
stated_stats: ~50% win rate, winners ~3x losers; ~25 trades/yr; -12% one year
data_needed: ASX data; would be US small caps for MCF
mcf_translation: daily bars: US small caps, close at 52-week/20-week high while index > 200-day MA; 10% or ATR trailing stop

setup_name: RSI 30-35 pullback buy in a long-term uptrend
universe_filter: index above its 50, 100 and 200-day moving averages
conditions: price > 50, 100 and 200-day SMA
daily RSI(14) falls to ~30-35
entry_trigger: buy at the close when RSI reaches 30-35
management: may also sell bearish call credit spreads at the RSI high
stated_edge: oversold readings inside a strong uptrend mark swing lows
mcf_translation: daily bars on SPY/QQQ/large caps: close > SMA50,100,200 and RSI14 <= 35 -> buy close; exit close when RSI14 >= 65

setup_name: Range breakout to all-time high with 5-EMA/10-SMA trail
universe_filter: stock in an extended sideways range
conditions: price ranged for a long period
close breaks out of the range to a new all-time high
target_or_exit: trail with close below the 10-day SMA, tightening to the 5-day EMA if the move accelerates
management: end-of-day stops only; risk 1% of capital
stated_edge: new highs out of long bases start trends; trailing captures the bulk
mcf_translation: daily bars: 60-day range width < X% and close > all-time (or 252-day) high -> buy; exit on close < SMA10 (or EMA5 after +2 ATR)

conditions: index closes back above its 200-day SMA
entry_trigger: buy at the close above the 200-day
target_or_exit: trail on 10-day SMA, then 5-day EMA if trend accelerates
management: end-of-day stops; size so loss to stop <= 1% of capital
stated_edge: long-term trend filter keeps you on the right side of the market
mcf_translation: daily SPY: cross above SMA200 -> long; exit close < SMA200 initially, later close < SMA10

universe_filter: markets in a clear larger trend or at a major turning point
conditions: price has fallen 50% from a major top, or retraced 50% of a prior low-to-high range
a double or triple bottom forms at that level (support tested before)
additional confluence: timing rule or volume behaviour (needs 3-4 factors)
entry_trigger: swing-chart reversal signal off the level (daily swing turns up)
target_or_exit: half off at a high-probability target (e.g. prior swing high); remainder trailed with the swing chart
management: add new units on subsequent swing signals; skip if entry-to-stop risk too large
stated_edge: informed holders bought at that level before and buy again; if the level breaks, the reverse trade (short the break) is also high probability
stated_stats: claims ~90% chance of some profit if managed (unverified)
mcf_translation: daily bars: find swing range (pivot low L to pivot high H); when low within 1% of (L+H)/2 and within 1.5% of a prior pivot low, buy on close above prior day high; stop below the pivot low; scale half at H-retest; mirror: short close below the double-bottom level

universe_filter: stock that topped at a level, pulled back ~20%, and returned to the top
conditions: prior high made
price retraces then rallies back to that high
selling appears on the retest (fails to hold above)
entry_trigger: swing-chart turns down from the retest
target_or_exit: half at first target, rest trailed
stated_edge: informed sellers sell again at the same price and trapped buyers from the first top exit at breakeven
mcf_translation: daily bars: high within 1% of a prior 20-120 day pivot high after a >=10% pullback, then close below prior day low -> short; stop above the higher of the two tops

universe_filter: one to a few names being watched for large-player activity
conditions: repeated large buying in blocks absorbing supply at a level (footprints on tape)
market backdrop supportive
entry_trigger: build position while accumulation is visible, before the release/breakout
target_or_exit: sell into strength in pieces as the breakout runs; mostly out by the top
management: scale out progressively; exit when tape turns
stated_edge: big players leave footprints; once their accumulation ends, sharp breakouts follow
data_needed: Level 2 and time-and-sales prints, options flow
mcf_translation: rough proxy: 5-min bars with tight range near a level on rising volume (volume up, range down for several bars) followed by a break of that level; exits in thirds into strength

setup_name: Fade the multi-day vertical spike in a listed small cap
time_of_day: any; while the stock is most volatile and liquid
universe_filter: top % gainers, listed, >= ~$5M dollar volume, news/earnings-driven run (e.g. $2 to $5 in a few days)
conditions: stock has gone near-vertical for several days on news
appears overextended; momentum stalling
entry_trigger: short when the spike stalls / turns (discretionary timing)
stop: break above the high of the run (new highs since the move started) - cover, never add
target_or_exit: 5-15% decline, take the predictable piece and move on
management: do not hold for the full month-long fade; do not average up
stated_edge: listed small-cap news spikes tend to fade back over the following weeks, like OTC pump-and-dumps but slower
mcf_translation: daily bars: price $1-20, 3-day return > 100%, dollar volume > $5M; next day short on 5-min break below opening range low or first red 5-min bar below VWAP; stop above run high; target -10% or close

universe_filter: stock in an active multi-week promotion/run with high volume
conditions: identify the highest price reached since the run began
price breaks above that high (new run high / multi-week high)
entry_trigger: buy as price trades through the prior run high
target_or_exit: hold for 1-3 day squeeze, sell into spike
management: size so the distance to the breakout level fits dollar risk
stated_edge: new highs in a controlled promotion attract a fresh buying rush and short squeeze
data_needed: OTC data and promotion flags; listed small caps only in MCF
mcf_translation: daily bars: stock up >100% over 20 days, buy stop at 20-day high + 1 tick, stop at prior day low, exit after 1-3 days or on close below prior day low

setup_name: VWAP bias trend-with trade in liquid large caps
universe_filter: highly liquid large and mega caps, not news-driven names
conditions: determine bias from price relative to session VWAP and how price interacts with it (holding above and pulling away = bullish; below = bearish)
heavy volume pulling VWAP toward price confirms participation
short-period RSI used only as timing confirmation
entry_trigger: enter in bias direction (partial size) once direction is clear; pullbacks toward VWAP give the safer entry
stop: thesis invalidated (not specified precisely; implicitly a decisive move back through VWAP)
target_or_exit: capture the middle portion of the move rather than top/bottom
stated_edge: institutions benchmark execution to VWAP so price reacts at it; only 2-3 signals a day define the major moves
mcf_translation: 5-min bars, top 100 liquid stocks: after 10:00, if close > VWAP for N bars and VWAP slope up, buy first pullback to within 0.1% of VWAP that closes back above; stop on 5-min close below VWAP minus 0.2%; exit at 2R or 15:45. Mirror for shorts

setup_name: Balance failure (failed breakout of a balance area)
instrument: futures (ES, CL, GC); applicable to liquid stocks/ETFs
universe_filter: liquid instrument that has formed a multi-session or intraday balance (tight range, fat volume profile)
conditions: market in balance: tight consolidation with a well-defined high and low
price pushes beyond one extreme (stops above highs / below lows get hit)
the breakout fails to hold and price comes back inside the balance quickly and forcefully
entry_trigger: enter in the opposite direction once price re-enters the balance after the poke outside
stop: beyond the extreme of the failed breakout
target_or_exit: the opposite side of the balance area (stops resting there fuel the move)
stated_edge: larger players push through the range to trigger stops for liquidity, then reverse; trapped breakout buyers are flushed
data_needed: futures data for original instruments; volume profile approximated
mcf_translation: 5-min or daily bars: define balance = prior N-bar (e.g. 2-5 day) high/low with range < X ATR; signal when a bar trades above balance high then a 5-min close back below it within 3 bars -> short; stop above the excursion high; target balance low (or mid at 1R). Mirror for lows

conditions: market inside established balance area
price reaches balance high or low
entry_trigger: fade at the extreme (limit orders resting at the edge)
stated_edge: extremes of balance are where responsive buyers/sellers act; middle is chop
mcf_translation: daily/5-min: when prior 5-day range is narrow relative to 20-day ATR, place limit buy at range low and sell at range high; stop 0.25 ATR beyond; target other side
